author: Legoche
body:
Malham Cove is a DTC map made by {tag=c29bef37d8e242a9b74604f2df78f374} , {tag=0b8f95fa0f404f289fd0b8e243bb6800} , {tag=9116d3fa14004adaaecd2eae1d73e383} and {tag=54964b606ce749229a4c2b981d8c2ed7} , with contributions from {tag=1c74c43029a0471fb30bcc2d9031ebcb} and {tag=cad8013ab98a40679f0981b0734e0085} .


I understand that DTC is not the next tournament game mode however I feel submitting this map with lots of time to spare will allow for much more testing and allow the map to be finalized over a period of time.

Map Overview
Loadout
Supplies

  • There are 2 monuments per team, each monument holds 37 endstone blocks.
  • There is 1 core per team.
  • Supplies are spread out across the map, with the main 2 supply rooms being in these 2 buildings.
  • Diamonds are spread across the frontlines, each one containing a TNT block. There are 61 diamond blocks on each side of the map.
  • Iron has been spread around the map inside the mountains.
  • There are two chests on the map containing these items, to allow for efficient core/monument defense.
  • The base of the map is all bedrock - subject to change.
We hope to work closely with the official team to test this map for tournament use - however, we understand that the map is NOT top priority at the moment - the map is subject to change, and will be edited alot throughout the testing period.
